welcomeScreen.title: Instagram Profile Lookup
welcomeScreen.intro: Enter an Instagram username above to look up its public profile metadata.
welcomeScreen.description: Works anonymously by default. Configure an imported browser session under Settings > API Keys to see data anonymous lookups can't reach - Instagram's ToS forbids automated access either way, so use a disposable account and expect it may get rate-limited or banned.

mode.anonymousInfo: Anonymous lookup - some data (followers/following lists, private-profile details) isn't visible without a session.
mode.sessionWarning: Using a configured Instagram session. Automated access violates Instagram's ToS - use a disposable account.

page.title: Scan followers, followees, or posts
page.description: Followers and followees need a session configured under Settings > API Keys - Instagram only shows either list to a logged-in request. Posts work anonymously too. Capped on item count and wall-clock time, and cancellable once running.

scanForm.sessionRequiredNote: Needs a configured Instagram session (Settings > API Keys) - Instagram requires being logged in to see this list, regardless of the profile's own privacy setting.
scanForm.limitsNote: Capped on item count and time - a large list is sampled, not walked in full.

results.truncatedNotice: Stopped before the full list was exhausted (item cap or time limit hit) - what was collected so far is shown below.
